这一刻。
随着锦衣卫接到沈浪的命令，开始行动。
曹阿瞒的脸色也瞬间苍白如纸！
一旁的李夫子见到这一幕，心头也是一颤，小声追问：“鱼塘下面有什么？”
“我……我的藏宝库！”曹阿瞒吞咽了口唾沫道。
“卧槽，上当了！”
听到这话，脑子并不笨的李夫子，立刻醒悟。
沈浪刚刚让他们离开，并不是打算暗中栽赃。
而是早就知道了曹阿瞒贪污巨大，给他们下套！
目的就是为了通过曹阿瞒的宝库，让他们难辞其咎！
意识到这件事貌似玩大了的李夫子，
说话的声音也变的前所未有的凝重：“你的宝库内，没什么危险物品吧？”
“没有！”曹阿瞒摇头。
“那就好！”李夫子松了口气。
但这口气还没咽下，曹阿瞒便补充道：“但里面有三百万灵石！”
“我尼玛……”
李夫子人麻了！
三百万灵石？
被锦衣卫当场抓到？

这踏马是死罪呀！
意识到自己这一波怕是被坑惨了的李夫子，只觉得自己的双腿都快站不稳了。
毕竟，他刚刚可是说了，要是曹阿瞒有罪，他被凌迟处死都行的！
“先生，您得救我呀！”
“这钱是我给王爷准备的生辰纲！”
曹阿瞒显然也很清楚，自己家中发现三百万灵石的巨款，是何等罪责。
为求活命，也是立刻将这笔钱的用途，告诉了李夫子。
李夫子闻言，恨铁不成钢道：“你踏马为什么不早点跟我说？”
“他们找了三遍也没找到，我也没想到，沈浪那个小畜生，一直都在钓鱼呀！”
听到曹阿瞒的这个解释，李夫子也是一脸无奈的叹了口气。
他知道，这一次曹阿瞒被逼上绝路，也怪不得他。
主要是沈浪那个小畜生，实在是太奸诈了。
于是，觉得此事只能等镇北王来救的李夫子，也是咬着后槽牙道：
“待会灵石被查出来，你就一口咬死说，这笔钱不知道是谁的，等王爷来营救你，明白吗？”
“好！”
曹阿瞒惶恐的点了点头。
殊不知。

This moment.
As the Jin Yiwei received Shen Lang's order, they began to take action.
Cao Aman's face instantly turned as pale as paper!
When Master Li on the side saw this scene, his heart trembled, and he asked in a low voice: "What's under the fish pond?"
"My...my treasure house!" Cao Ah'an swallowed and said.
"Damn it, I was fooled!"
After hearing this, Master Li, who was not stupid, immediately woke up.
Shen Lang just asked them to leave, not intending to frame them secretly.
But they already knew that Cao Ahao was embezzling huge amounts of money and set a trap for them!
The purpose is to pass Cao Ah Ma's treasure house so that they can't escape the blame!
Realizing that this matter seemed to be a big deal, Mr. Li
His voice became more solemn than ever before: "There are no dangerous items in your treasure house, right?"
"No!" Cao Aman shook his head.
"That's good!" Master Li breathed a sigh of relief.
But before he could swallow his breath, Cao Aman added: "But there are three million spiritual stones in it!"
"I'm sorry..."
Mrs. Li is numb!
Three million spirit stones?
Caught red-handed by Jin Yiwei?
It is a capital offense to step on a horse!
Master Li, who realized that he might have been deceived this time, felt that his legs were almost unsteady.
After all, he just said that if Cao Ahao was guilty, he would be executed by Lingchi!
"Sir, you have to save me!"
"This money is the birthday plan I prepared for the prince!"
Cao A'ao obviously also knew very well how guilty it was to find a huge sum of three million spiritual stones in his home.
In order to survive, he immediately told Master Li the purpose of the money.
Master Li heard this and said, "Why didn't you tell me earlier?"
"They searched three times but couldn't find it. I didn't expect that little beast Shen Lang has been fishing all this time!"
After hearing this explanation from Cao Amo, Master Li also sighed helplessly.
He knew that it was no wonder that Cao Ah Ma was forced to a dead end this time.
Mainly because that little beast Shen Lang is so cunning.
Therefore, Master Li, who felt that he could only wait for King Zhenbei to come to rescue him, gritted his molars and said:
"When the spiritual stone is discovered, you will insist that you don't know whose money this money belongs to, and you will wait until the prince comes to rescue you, do you understand?"
"Okay!"
Cao A nodded fearfully.
Little did I know.
